description: 初始版本，支持SSH解析和单位标准化
content:
name: Linux服务器安全配置基线
version: "2.0"
description: 优化后的默认Linux服务器安全配置基线，支持SSH配置解析和内核参数单位标准化

checks:
  ssh:
    - id: SSH-001
      name: 禁止root用户直接登录
      description: 确保SSH不允许root用户直接登录
      severity: high
      check_type: ssh_config
      sshd_key: PermitRootLogin
      expected_value: "no"
      fix_command: sed -i 's/^PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd

    - id: SSH-002
      name: 禁用空密码登录
      description: 确保SSH不允许空密码登录
      severity: high
      check_type: ssh_config
      sshd_key: PermitEmptyPasswords
      expected_value: "no"
      fix_command: sed -i 's/^PermitEmptyPasswords.*/PermitEmptyPasswords no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd

    - id: SSH-003
      name: 禁用密码认证（推荐使用密钥）
      description: 确保SSH禁用密码认证，使用密钥认证
      severity: medium
      check_type: ssh_config
      sshd_key: PasswordAuthentication
      expected_value: "no"
      fix_command: sed -i 's/^PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd

    - id: SSH-004
      name: 设置SSH空闲超时时间
      description: 确保SSH设置空闲超时自动断开（5分钟）
      severity: medium
      check_type: ssh_config
      sshd_key: ClientAliveInterval
      expected_value: "300"
      unit: seconds
      compare: ge
      fix_command: echo -e 'ClientAliveInterval 300\nClientAliveCountMax 0' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd

    - id: SSH-005
      name: 禁用X11转发
      description: 确保SSH禁用X11转发
      severity: low
      check_type: ssh_config
      sshd_key: X11Forwarding
      expected_value: "no"
      fix_command: sed -i 's/^X11Forwarding.*/X11Forwarding no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd

    - id: SSH-006
      name: SSH端口监听检查
      description: 确保SSH服务在配置的端口上正常监听
      severity: high
      check_type: port_listening
      expected_status: listening
      fix_command: systemctl restart sshd

    - id: SSH-007
      name: 限制最大认证尝试次数
      description: 限制SSH最大认证尝试次数防止暴力破解
      severity: medium
      check_type: ssh_config
      sshd_key: MaxAuthTries
      expected_value: "4"
      unit: count
      compare: le
      fix_command: sed -i 's/^MaxAuthTries.*/MaxAuthTries 4/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd

    - id: SSH-008
      name: 禁用用户环境变量
      description: 禁用SSH用户环境变量读取
      severity: low
      check_type: ssh_config
      sshd_key: PermitUserEnvironment
      expected_value: "no"
      fix_command: sed -i 's/^PermitUserEnvironment.*/PermitUserEnvironment no/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config && systemctl restart sshd

  firewall:
    - id: FIREWALL-001
      name: 防火墙已启用
      description: 确保firewalld或iptables服务已启用
      severity: high
      check_type: service_status
      service_name: firewalld
      expected_status: active
      alt_service_name: iptables
      fix_command: systemctl enable firewalld && systemctl start firewalld

    - id: FIREWALL-002
      name: 默认拒绝策略
      description: 确保防火墙默认策略为拒绝
      severity: high
      check_type: command
      command: iptables -L INPUT --line-numbers | head -1
      expected_output: "policy DROP"
      match_type: contains
      fix_command: iptables -P INPUT DROP && iptables -P FORWARD DROP && iptables -P OUTPUT ACCEPT

    - id: FIREWALL-003
      name: 限制SSH连接频率
      description: 确保SSH连接有频率限制防止暴力破解
      severity: medium
      check_type: command
      command: iptables -S INPUT | grep -E 'dport 22.*limit' || true
      expected_output: limit
      match_type: contains
      fix_command: iptables -I INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -m state --state NEW -m limit --limit 5/minute --limit-burst 10 -j ACCEPT

  kernel:
    - id: KERNEL-001
      name: 禁用IP转发
      description: 确保服务器不作为路由器转发IP包
      severity: high
      check_type: sysctl
      parameter: net.ipv4.ip_forward
      expected_value: "0"
      fix_command: echo 'net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0' >> /etc/sysctl.conf && sysctl -p

    - id: KERNEL-002
      name: 启用SYN洪水保护
      description: 启用TCP SYN cookies防范SYN洪水攻击
      severity: high
      check_type: sysctl
      parameter: net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies
      expected_value: "1"
      fix_command: echo 'net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1' >> /etc/sysctl.conf && sysctl -p

    - id: KERNEL-003
      name: 禁用ICMP重定向接受
      description: 禁用ICMP重定向防止中间人攻击
      severity: medium
      check_type: sysctl
      parameter: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects
      expected_value: "0"
      fix_command: echo 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0' >> /etc/sysctl.conf && sysctl -p

    - id: KERNEL-004
      name: 禁用源路由接受
      description: 禁用IP源路由接受
      severity: medium
      check_type: sysctl
      parameter: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route
      expected_value: "0"
      fix_command: echo 'net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0' >> /etc/sysctl.conf && sysctl -p

    - id: KERNEL-005
      name: 启用地址空间随机化
      description: 启用ASLR地址空间布局随机化
      severity: medium
      check_type: sysctl
      parameter: kernel.randomize_va_space
      expected_value: "2"
      fix_command: echo 'kernel.randomize_va_space = 2' >> /etc/sysctl.conf && sysctl -p

    - id: KERNEL-006
      name: 记录可疑数据包
      description: 记录异常和伪造的数据包
      severity: low
      check_type: sysctl
      parameter: net.ipv4.conf.all.log_martians
      expected_value: "1"
      fix_command: echo 'net.ipv4.conf.all.log_martians = 1' >> /etc/sysctl.conf && sysctl -p

    - id: KERNEL-007
      name: TCP最大缓冲区大小
      description: 确保TCP发送缓冲区大小足够
      severity: low
      check_type: sysctl
      parameter: net.ipv4.tcp_wmem
      expected_value: "4194304"
      unit: bytes
      compare: ge
      fix_command: echo 'net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 87380 4194304' >> /etc/sysctl.conf && sysctl -p

    - id: KERNEL-008
      name: 最大文件句柄数
      description: 确保系统最大文件句柄数足够
      severity: medium
      check_type: sysctl
      parameter: fs.file-max
      expected_value: "65535"
      unit: count
      compare: ge
      fix_command: echo 'fs.file-max = 65535' >> /etc/sysctl.conf && sysctl -p

  users:
    - id: USER-001
      name: 空密码账户检查
      description: 检查是否存在空密码的用户账户
      severity: critical
      check_type: command
      command: "awk -F: '($2 == \"\") {print $1}' /etc/shadow"
      match_type: exact
      fix_command: passwd -l <username>

    - id: USER-002
      name: UID为0的账户检查
      description: 检查除root外是否有其他UID为0的账户
      severity: critical
      check_type: command
      command: "awk -F: '($3 == 0 && $1 != \"root\") {print $1}' /etc/passwd"
      match_type: exact
      fix_command: userdel -r <username>

    - id: USER-003
      name: sudoers配置检查
      description: 检查sudoers文件权限是否正确
      severity: high
      check_type: file_permission
      file_path: /etc/sudoers
      expected_permission: "440"
      expected_owner: root
      expected_group: root
      fix_command: chmod 440 /etc/sudoers && chown root:root /etc/sudoers

    - id: USER-004
      name: 检查无主文件
      description: 查找系统中无属主或属组的文件
      severity: medium
      check_type: command
      command: find / -xdev -nouser -o -nogroup 2>/dev/null | head -20
      match_type: exact
      fix_command: find / -xdev -nouser -o -nogroup -exec chown root:root {} \;

  files:
    - id: FILE-001
      name: /etc/passwd权限检查
      description: 确保/etc/passwd文件权限正确
      severity: high
      check_type: file_permission
      file_path: /etc/passwd
      expected_permission: "644"
      expected_owner: root
      expected_group: root
      fix_command: chmod 644 /etc/passwd && chown root:root /etc/passwd

    - id: FILE-002
      name: /etc/shadow权限检查
      description: 确保/etc/shadow文件权限正确
      severity: critical
      check_type: file_permission
      file_path: /etc/shadow
      expected_permission: "000"
      expected_owner: root
      expected_group: root
      fix_command: chmod 000 /etc/shadow && chown root:root /etc/shadow

    - id: FILE-003
      name: /etc/gshadow权限检查
      description: 确保/etc/gshadow文件权限正确
      severity: high
      check_type: file_permission
      file_path: /etc/gshadow
      expected_permission: "000"
      expected_owner: root
      expected_group: root
      fix_command: chmod 000 /etc/gshadow && chown root:root /etc/gshadow

    - id: FILE-004
      name: /etc/group权限检查
      description: 确保/etc/group文件权限正确
      severity: medium
      check_type: file_permission
      file_path: /etc/group
      expected_permission: "644"
      expected_owner: root
      expected_group: root
      fix_command: chmod 644 /etc/group && chown root:root /etc/group

    - id: FILE-005
      name: 世界可写文件检查
      description: 查找系统中世界可写的文件（排除临时目录）
      severity: medium
      check_type: command
      command: find / -xdev -type f -perm -0002 -not -path '/proc/*' -not -path '/sys/*' -not -path '/tmp/*' -not -path '/var/tmp/*' 2>/dev/null | head -20
      match_type: exact
      fix_command: chmod o-w <filename>

    - id: FILE-006
      name: SUID/SGID文件检查
      description: 检查系统中的SUID和SGID文件
      severity: low
      check_type: command
      command: find / -xdev -type f \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) 2>/dev/null | head -20
      match_type: exists
      warn_only: true
      fix_command: "# 审核SUID/SGID文件，移除不必要的特殊权限"
